answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. Like a steady comet tracing its orbit, an agent must lock collateral to participate, making identity synthesis a costly endeavor. An attacker attempting a reef of fake nodes faces the gale force of economic slashing, as the prohibitive cost of acquiring sufficient stake renders the creation of numerous fraudulent identities fiscally ruinous to the adversary.
